title: Bohemian Grove: What Is Documented
summary: The Bohemian Club (est. 1872) holds an annual all-male summer encampment at Monte Rio, CA; the opening 'Cremation of Care' is a theatrical pageant (filmed by infiltrators in 2000). On White House tapes (May 13, 1971) Nixon called it 'the most faggy goddamned thing you could ever imagine... I attend from time to time.' No primary-source evidence supports claims of satanic rituals or human sacrifice; no criminal case has ever been tied to the Grove.
